targets.rawSql: SELECT full_name AS repository_path, sig_score AS significance_score FROM hidden_gem_repo_scores(${alpha}::float, ${beta}::float, ${hours}::int, CASE WHEN '${language:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${language:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${license:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${license:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${topic:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${topic:csv}', ',') END) WHERE sig_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sig_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

panels.description: Poisson CDF and Sig Score for filtered repositories.

targets.rawSql: SELECT repo_id::text, name AS repository_name, full_name AS repository_path, language, license_spdx, count_stars_interval, count_forks_interval, poisson_cdf, sig_score AS significance_score, last_event_in_window FROM hidden_gem_repo_scores(${alpha}::float, ${beta}::float, ${hours}::int, CASE WHEN '${language:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${language:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${license:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${license:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${topic:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${topic:csv}', ',') END) WHERE sig_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sig_score DESC NULLS LAST;
